author: Pascal Obry
name: pdf_slideshow
description: Adds an exporter that generates a PDF slideshow with one selected image per slide and configurable titles and transition delays.
description-extensive: This tool turns your selected photos into a PDF slideshow, placing one picture per page with an optional caption showing the title and photographer. You can set a slideshow title and a delay between slides for automatic playback. It requires the pdflatex program (part of LaTeX) to build the PDF and a PDF viewer to display it.
